publication.title: FIRST Robotics teams around Fort Wayne
publication.distance_definition: Straight-line great-circle distance, not road travel distance
publication.leadership_policy: Preserve exact documented role and evidence date. A mentor, drive-team captain, representative, former captain, or indexed first-name-only announcement is not silently upgraded to current overall captain or head coach.
publication.artifact_preservation_note: No report or spreadsheet file was saved in the initial chat research. The repository package is newly assembled from that research and fresh captures, with source timestamps preserved and new capture times recorded. It does not contain private conversation context or internal reasoning.

distance_method.location_rule: Linked high-school campus or community-host reference point; Matthews uses a clearly labeled town representative point because a physical team address was not confirmed.
distance_method.exhaustiveness_note: This file verifies the identified roster and named exclusions. It is not a census of every FIRST program, a verified inventory of all team workshops, or proof that no unlisted community team exists.
